name: 02-midtransition-baseline-f8a7b21
description: Night baseline sampled during a lighting transition is unrepresentatively LOW (here a dip to 1200 right in the baseline_delay_s window against a true resting level of 3500), making day_gain_pct% of it a bar no real light source can reach - the incident scene sat at a rock-stable 65% of baseline, visibly lit, and stayed night indefinitely. The symmetric EMA drift must self-correct the baseline back up, and the sustained-brightening probe must then get a genuinely lit scene (night pipe 900, day pipe 250) out to day.
